controls.label: Platform Search
controls.description: Search Organizations, Sites and internal registry-backed resources.

controls.label: Organization Context Selector
controls.description: Switch internal Organization context without changing authorization.

controls.label: Site Context Selector
controls.description: Switch Site context after server-side scope validation.

controls.label: Environment Reference
controls.description: Show environment identity and URL references; never hosting billing controls.

controls.label: Contract Version Status
controls.description: Pinned contract version, compatibility status and supported upgrade path.

controls.label: Module & Capability Manager
controls.description: Enable/disable only capabilities allowed by Module Registry and Site Manifest rules.

controls.label: API Binding Status
controls.description: Configured API groups/versions and runtime health without exposing secrets.

controls.label: Connection Health
controls.description: Site/integration/runtime connectivity and last successful check.

controls.label: Secret Status
controls.description: Presence/rotation/expiry metadata only; never reveal stored secret values.

controls.label: Recent Authentication Gate
controls.description: Require recent authentication for sensitive/privileged operations.

controls.label: Explicit Confirmation
controls.description: Require deliberate confirmation for destructive or high-impact operations.

controls.label: Risk Badge
controls.description: Non-color-only visual indication of permission/action risk.

controls.label: Audit Timeline
controls.description: Actor/action/time/request context without secrets.

controls.label: Event Log Viewer
controls.description: Canonical Event envelope, producer, correlation and delivery status.

controls.label: Webhook Delivery Viewer
controls.description: Attempts, response metadata, retry/dead-letter state and signature version.

controls.label: Diagnostic Check
controls.description: Bounded platform/site health check with evidence and remediation.

controls.label: Migration Dry Run
controls.description: Preview compatibility impact before any migration execution.

controls.label: Migration Execution
controls.description: Privileged migration action gated by compatibility and rollback policy.

controls.label: Support Context
controls.description: Organization/Site support data without silently assuming the customer identity.

controls.label: Customer CMS Link
controls.description: Navigate to the customer workspace as the current admin identity; no hidden impersonation.

controls.label: Override Control
controls.description: Use only when a canonical rule explicitly permits an administrative override.

controls.label: Data Classification
controls.description: Show public/internal/personal/sensitive/secret handling class where known.

controls.label: Freshness & Provenance
controls.description: Show source and freshness for imported/reporting data.

controls.label: Transaction Snapshot
controls.description: Read-only historical commerce snapshot protected from catalog edits.

controls.label: Command Result
controls.description: Display server-authoritative command success/failure/request ID and resulting state.
